dracthyr.summary: Dragon soldiers made from the essence of all five dragonflights: they glide, strike with wings and tail, wear a humanoid visage, and from level 5 take short flights.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Gliding Wings
traits.summary: In natural form and not Incapacitated: a fall counts up to 100 ft less for damage, and you drift 2 ft sideways per 1 ft you drop.

traits.name: Natural Weaponry
traits.summary: In natural form, Bonus Action: an Unarmed Strike with wings or tail to Shove a creature.

traits.name: Visage
traits.summary: Magic action: switch between your natural form and a humanoid visage whose look you set when you pick the species; clothing, gear and statistics don't change.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: From level 5, Bonus Action: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

draenei.summary: Exiled eredar shaped by the naaru, fel or the Legion: darkvision, a lineage of resistance and spells, and Heroic Inspiration when they cast those spells.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Eredar Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Draenei, Krokul, Lightforged or Man'ari: a resistance and a cantrip at level 1, then a spell at levels 3 and 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the lineage.

traits.name: Heroic Presence
traits.summary: Casting a spell from your Eredar Lineage gives you Heroic Inspiration if you lack it. Once per Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Draenei
options.summary: Necrotic Resistance and Spare the Dying; Healing Word at 3, Prayer of Healing at 5.

options.name: Krokul
options.summary: Poison Resistance and Poison Spray; Ray of Sickness at 3, Hold Person at 5.

options.name: Lightforged
options.summary: Radiant Resistance and Sacred Flame; Guiding Bolt at 3, Aid at 5.

options.name: Man'ari
options.summary: Fire Resistance and Fire Bolt; Hellish Rebuke at 3, Darkness at 5.

dwarf-warcraft.summary: Hardy descendants of the stone earthen: long darkvision, poison resistance, extra HP every level and a stone-borne tremorsense.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.summary: Poison Resistance, and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.summary: +1 HP maximum, and +1 more each level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while on or touching stone (natural or worked). PB times per Long Rest.

earthen.summary: Titan-made folk of living, Azerite-veined stone who resist poison, need no food, and trade an attack for a cone that heals friends and burns foes.

traits.name: Azerite Surge
traits.summary: Replace one attack of your Attack action with a 15-ft Cone: chosen creatures heal 1d10, the rest make a DEX save (DC 8 + PB + CON) for 1d10 Radiant, half on success. Both grow to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11 and 4d10 at 17; PB times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Earthen Resilience
traits.summary: Poison Resistance, and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Ingest Minerals
traits.summary: Malnutrition never gives you Exhaustion.

traits.name: Quiet Contemplation
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent at the end of a Short Rest each heal 1 extra HP.

elf-warcraft.summary: Azeroth's elves (night elves, nightborne, high, blood and void elves): darkvision, fey-touched minds, trance, and a lineage of innate spells.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Blood Elf, High Elf, Night Elf, Nightborne or Void Elf: its level 1 benefit, then a spell at levels 3 and 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the lineage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.summary: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.summary: No sleep needed and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of conscious meditation.

options.name: Blood Elf
options.summary: Prestidigitation, which you can swap for another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3, Arcane Vigor at 5.

options.name: High Elf
options.summary: Prestidigitation, which you can swap for another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3, Misty Step at 5.

options.name: Night Elf
options.summary: Stealth proficiency, and Hide as a Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness; Longstrider at 3, Pass without Trace at 5.

options.name: Nightborne
options.summary: Darkvision grows to 120 ft, and Arcane Pulse; Faerie Fire at 3, Darkness at 5.

options.name: Void Elf
options.summary: Darkvision grows to 120 ft, and Mind Sliver; Entropic Embrace at 3, Misty Step at 5.

forsaken.summary: Undead freed from the Lich King's will: necrotic resistance, no need for breath, food or sleep, and a once-a-day life-draining strike.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Deathly Endurance
traits.summary: Necrotic Resistance.

traits.name: Everlasting
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation; no sleep needed and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of motionless, conscious rest.

traits.name: Touch of the Grave
traits.summary: When you deal damage to a creature, add PB d4s of Necrotic damage and regain HP equal to that extra damage. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Will of the Forsaken
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened.

gnome-warcraft.summary: Tinkering gnomes of Gnomeregan, or mechagnomes who rebuilt themselves as living machines: pick one at creation.

traits.name: Gnome or Mechagnome
traits.summary: Choose gnome (Humanoid: Darkvision, Gnomish Cunning, Gnomish Lineage) or mechagnome (Construct: Built for Success, Emergency Fail-Safe, Mechanical Nature, Sentry's Rest, Specialized Design); your pick's traits are listed with it.

options.name: Gnome
options.summary: Humanoid. Darkvision 60 ft, Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves, and the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; a 10-minute Prestidigitation casting builds a Tiny clockwork gadget (AC 5, 1 HP).

options.name: Darkvision
options.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

options.name: Gnomish Cunning
options.summary: Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.

options.name: Gnomish Lineage
options.summary: Know Mending and Prestidigitation. Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to build a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) that repeats one chosen effect of the spell whenever someone touches it as a Bonus Action; up to three at once, each falling apart after 8 hours or when you take it apart (Utilize action).

options.name: Mechagnome
options.summary: Construct, Small (about 4 ft). Add 1d4 to D20 Tests, heal with a Reaction when Bloodied, resist poison, rest 6 hours without sleep, and two tool proficiencies.

options.name: Built for Success
options.summary: Add 1d4 to a D20 Test, even after rolling but before the result. PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Emergency Fail-Safe
options.summary: Reaction on becoming Bloodied: spend and roll one Hit Point Die, healing the roll + CON (minimum 1). Once per Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Mechanical Nature
options.summary: Poison Resistance; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Paralyzed or Poisoned; no Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation.

options.name: Sentry's Rest
options.summary: No sleep needed; a Long Rest takes 6 hours of motionless, conscious rest.

options.name: Specialized Design
options.summary: Proficiency with two tools of your choice.

goblin.summary: Kezan's quick-witted cartel folk: they shrug off charms, slip away as a Bonus Action and hit bigger foes harder.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.summary: When your attack or spell damages a creature larger than you, add damage equal to PB of the same type. PB times per Long Rest, at most once per turn.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.summary: Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

haranir.summary: Secretive druidic folk of Harandar, the realm under the World Trees' roots: long darkvision, nature lore, and thorny innate magic.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Gift of the World Trees
traits.summary: Proficiency in Nature and Survival.

traits.name: Haranir Magic
traits.summary: Know Druidcraft and Thorn Whip; Entangle at level 3 and Spike Growth at 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the species.

human-warcraft.summary: Azeroth's humans, from Stormwind to Kul Tiras and the Arathi Empire, use the Player's Handbook human traits; their homelands add Origin feats such as Arathi Heritage, Child of the Sea and Will to Survive.
human-warcraft.sizeText: Medium or Small (chosen with the species), as the Player's Handbook human

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.summary: An Origin feat of your choice; Dalaran humans often take Magic Initiate (Wizard).

orc-warcraft.summary: Draenor-born orcs of the Horde: long darkvision, bursts of speed that toughen them, and refusing to fall.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.summary: Bonus Action: Dash and gain Temporary HP equal to PB. PB times per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: Dropped to 0 HP but not killed outright: go to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

pandaren.summary: Easygoing bear-folk of Pandaria and the Wandering Isle: they bounce off falls, recover well on rests and slip past foes they strike.

traits.name: Bouncy
traits.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from falling.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Inner Peace
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent after a Short Rest each heal 1 extra HP.

traits.name: Quaking Palm
traits.summary: Once you land a melee hit on a creature during your turn, moving doesn't provoke that creature's Opportunity Attacks until the turn ends.

tauren.summary: Towering bovine folk of Mulgore, Highmountain and Northrend who gore and shove with their horns and carry a lineage gift.

traits.name: Horns
traits.summary: An Unarmed Strike that deals damage can deal 1d6 + STR Piercing instead of its normal damage.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.summary: Right after you Dash and move 20+ ft on your turn, Bonus Action: one Unarmed Strike.

traits.name: Hammering Horns
traits.summary: Right after a melee hit during your Attack action, Bonus Action: Shove that target (within 5 ft) with an Unarmed Strike, pushing it up to 10 ft.

traits.name: Tauren Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Mulgore, Highmountain or Taunka. Its save DCs are 8 + PB + STR, CON or WIS (picked with the lineage).

options.name: Mulgore Tauren
options.summary: War stomp: swap one attack of your Attack action for a stomp; chosen creatures in a 5-ft Emanation make a CON save or are Stunned until your turn ends. Not while Prone, flying, climbing or swimming.

options.name: Highmountain Tauren
options.summary: Action: move up to your Speed through creatures' spaces without provoking Opportunity Attacks; each Medium or smaller creature you enter makes a STR save or takes PB + STR damage and falls Prone (once per turn each).

options.name: Taunka
options.summary: +1 AC and Cold Resistance from a shaggy hide.

troll.summary: Ancient loa-worshipping folk of Azeroth's jungles, forests and ice: they fight harder when hurt, heal fast on rests and carry a tribal lineage.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.summary: Advantage on attack rolls while Bloodied.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Troll Healing
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent after a Short Rest heal their maximum roll plus your CON modifier instead of being rolled.

traits.name: Troll Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Amani, Darkspear or Zandalari troll.

options.name: Amani Troll
options.summary: Spending Heroic Inspiration restores 1 spent Hit Point Die.

options.name: Darkspear Troll
options.summary: When you Dash, Difficult Terrain of ice, rubble, snow or undergrowth costs no extra movement until your turn ends.

options.name: Zandalari Troll
options.summary: A natural 1 on a D20 Test gives you Heroic Inspiration at the end of that turn.

vulpera.summary: Small fox-folk desert caravaners: fire resistant, hard to pin down, and quick to brace for the first blow of a fight.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.summary: Fire Resistance.

traits.name: Nose for Trouble
traits.summary: The first damage you take after rolling Initiative drops by your level (minimum 0).

traits.name: Vulpera Nimbleness
traits.summary: Pass through (but not stop in) the space of a creature a size larger than you.

worgen.summary: Gilneans carrying the wolf curse, now under control: they shift into a bestial form that is faster, tougher and harder to pin down.

traits.name: Darkflight
traits.summary: Bonus Action: take a bestial form for 1 minute (revert as a Bonus Action) and gain Temporary HP equal to 2 × PB. PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Increased Speed
options.summary: +10 ft Speed.

options.name: Reactive Movement
options.summary: Reaction when a creature finishes its turn within 5 ft of you: move up to 10 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Necrotic Resistance
options.summary: Necrotic Resistance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Instinctual Shift
traits.summary: On rolling Initiative with a Darkflight use left, shift into bestial form at once (no action).
